comms_internal: This is one of the many construction that can be used to express the idea of being ill / having some disease. It is surprising all these constructions have different patterns. 1) One possibility is to use a special verb, like “zuʔuf-a hıkıs” [ill-predic m.be.inf] ‘to have flu’. It is used in a construction where the name of the disease is not expressed as a separate NP: “aˁhmaˁd zuʔuf-a yişi i” [Ahmed sick-predic m.be.pf m.cop] ‘Ahmed has the flu’. 2) “aˁhmaˁd-id sarılıx yişi i” [PN-attr.n jaundice(n) n.be.pfv n.cop] ‘Ahmed has jaundice’, used with the ATTR_NOM pattern. 3) “aˁhmaˁd-ıkla mır yibq’ı viʔi” [PN-contel hives(a) a.come.pfv a.cop] ‘Ahmed has hives’.
